proposals.post_text: 5 minutes after a new tool drops: (1) Save 1+ hr/week? → Archive if no. (2) Works with tools I use? → Archive if no. (3) Cost < $20/mo? → Archive if no. (4) Install in <4 hrs? → Archive if no. (5) Usage-based? → Archive if no. 4 of 5 passes = install it.

48h is the iteration cycle. Not the survival rate.
The 14-day business-survival denominator is never measured.
Agent output has a 4-hour task half-life.
"Launched" doesn't mean "retained."
The era of AI founders is over before it begins.
